tasks.label: Build AnchorFeeds
tasks.command: $projectBin = '${workspaceFolder}\AnchorFeeds\bin'; Get-Process -Name AnchorFeeds -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -and $_.Path.StartsWith($projectBin, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force }; dotnet build "${workspaceFolder}\AnchorFeeds\AnchorFeeds.csproj"

tasks.label: Publish AnchorFeeds (Release, single file)
tasks.command: $projectBin = '${workspaceFolder}\AnchorFeeds\bin'; Get-Process -Name AnchorFeeds -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -and $_.Path.StartsWith($projectBin, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force }; dotnet publish "${workspaceFolder}\AnchorFeeds\AnchorFeeds.csproj" -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true
